verdict.rationale: Gumroad's own materials say a creator can upload a file, set a price and start selling online, with customers paying in their own currency, and early community feedback highlights speed and ease of use. The evidence never explicitly mentions card payments or a time-to-first-payment within a day. Card processing is only implied by a community code grep that found Stripe and PayPal. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of card acceptance at checkout, any documented onboarding or activation timeline showing payments can be accepted within a day, hands-on confirmation of a first card sale shortly after signup.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: I upload a file, set a price, and I can start selling on the internet.
Let your customers pay in their own currency.
They saw speed and ease of use as the big selling point.
